misc-num-01-c1.text: Lowell Observatory (2021). View from Mars Hill: The planets and their ties to the days of the week. Lowell Observatory.
misc-num-01-c1.quote: The Sun and Moon were especially obvious, but five other bodies also highlighted the night skies.
misc-num-01-c1.claim: Seven matches the number of visible 'wandering stars' (sun, moon, five planets).

misc-num-01-c3.text: P. J. Williams (2007). P115 and the Number of the Beast. Tyndale Bulletin 58(1).
misc-num-01-c3.quote: One of the consistently popular proposals of the modern period is that 666 stands for Nero Caesar
misc-num-01-c3.claim: Add up the Hebrew letters of 'Nero Caesar', נרון קסר, and you get 666.

misc-num-01-c3.text: P. J. Williams (2007). P115 and the Number of the Beast. Tyndale Bulletin 58(1).
misc-num-01-c3.quote: The manuscript is now the oldest surviving manuscript witness to this reading.
misc-num-01-c3.claim: The earliest manuscripts also include the variant 616, which corresponds to the Latin spelling 'Nero Caesar'.
